about: SCION 11 · Video Puppetry Tabletop — every asset in film.mp4, where it came from, its rights, and the operation that made it.

assets.what: the dog, profile facing left, head raised: the main puppet (watching, backing away, approaching, lying across the sill, looking in)
assets.source: paeleo/handmade/kit/archive-dog/frames/f006.jpg with its SAM mask (kit masks.json, frame 6)
assets.source_title: Amateur Film New Jersey C (Home Movies collection, Internet Archive)
assets.operation: mask, tone-normalised, split into per-piece masks: a body sheet bent by rigid moving-least-squares on 12 handles; head-with-neck (cut along a neck line), tail (cut along a tail line) and four legs (below a belly line, by distance to each leg's axis) as rigid cut-outs pinned at joints and placed by least-squares rigid fit of their handles; mirrored (R) for the turned back

assets.what: the same dog three-quarter to the camera: the middle of both turns (F and its mirror F')
assets.operation: as dog-L (mask, tone, pieces, 24 handles: proof/handles_F.png), mirrored for F'; warped toward the profile keys' handle positions and dissolved over ~16% of a turn segment; F' and F swapped like cut-outs (no morph) with a 14% narrowing at the swap

assets.what: the back of the dog's head while it looks in through the door (26.46-28.2 s)
assets.source: real fur pixels of kit frame 6 (paeleo/handmade/kit/archive-dog/frames/f006.jpg, the dark mane at about x 117-147, y 91-140)
assets.operation: cut with a crisp mask drawn here (ellipse skull, two triangular ears, feathered nape); 1 px dark outline; pinned on the neck by a rigid transform; hard cut in and out

assets.what: the person's forearm and hand (reaching, then offered low)
assets.source: /home/user/hartswf0/secondhand-motion/shots/hand-sam/frames/f000.jpg and its SAM mask (kit found-frames.json entry 'hand'); the forearm beyond the SAM mask cut by a hand-placed polygon
assets.source_title: The Door to Heaven (Internet Archive, via the kit's found-frames)
assets.operation: mask, tone-normalise, mirror (it reaches right), placed each frame by a two-point (elbow, wrist) similarity transform, tinted to the dusk; a real hand holding a card edge in the source, the card is masked out

assets.what: the person's legs, coat, head, hair and upper arm
assets.operation: drawn as flat card pieces, moved by rigid tracked transforms per frame (stand, call lean, reach, step aside, sit, low arm) from the score's person channels

assets.what: dusk sky bands, cut-paper moon, tree line, yard, deck rail, clapboard house wall with window, door frame trim, door card (hinged, swings in), lit room with lamp and table, porch planks, sill stone, fascia, corner post
assets.operation: synthesized: polygons with jittered (scissor) edges, procedural paper-fibre texture, soft drop shadows between layers; light pool and wall glow computed from the door opening

assets.what: two calls 'come here', two soft 'it's all right', soft 'come in' (formant synthesis); wind and crickets; paw taps at every foot plant of the gait; paper rustles at turns and lie-downs; door latch and creak; a low room hum when the door opens; a breath when the dog settles
assets.operation: synthesized (glottal pulse train through three time-varying formant resonators, filtered noise); levels measured in data/sound_levels.json

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display, JetBrains Mono on the title and end cards
assets.rights: SIL Open Font License (repository font kit)

assets.what: the dog's decision trace that drives the performance
assets.operation: read only: build/perform.py derives the performance clip data/performance.json from it

not_used: no web images, no commercial film, no generated images from any model; the kit's archive-door footage and Quick, Draw! drawings were looked at and not used; kit frame 0 (a back-of-head piece) was tried in repair rounds 1-2 and retired in round 3
